summary: Iteration 29 - Post-refactor regression test for documents/routes.py + generators.py + transactions_export template, and 3 split frontend tabs (DetailsTab, PaymentTrackingTab, CommunicationTab). 19/19 backend tests passed. All 3 customer-detail tabs render and behave correctly. No regressions introduced by the refactor.

minor.issue: Response document object has `_id: None` key (Pydantic alias). Not a real ObjectId leak, but unnecessary noise in payload — recommend serializing with by_alias=False or excluding _id.

critical_code_review_comments: documents/generators.py cleanly dispatches by DocumentType with a SIMPLE_GENERATORS map + async renderers for schedule/agreement/demand. Good separation.
documents/templates/transactions_export.py extracted as expected; the route wraps it in JSON {content, customer_name} (unchanged contract).

All 11 doc types (DocumentType enum) generate successfully: sales_agreement, price_breakup, cost_breakup, allotment_letter, noc_hdfc/bob/tata, demand_letter, welcome_letter, disbursement_letter, payment_schedule (skipped when no schedule).

Note: 'booking_form' and 'terms_and_conditions' listed in problem statement are NOT in DocumentType enum — these templates exist only for preview endpoints, not for POST /api/documents/generate. Pre-existing, not a refactor regression.

Frontend tabs DetailsTab, PaymentTrackingTab, CommunicationTab now correctly compose smaller subcomponents (details/, payment/, communication/). All edit/save buttons, dialogs, and data render with same props/contract as before.
Customer dispatcher in generators.py uses `customer.get('id')` consistently; matches existing routes (no UUID mismatch observed).
seed_data_creation: None. Created one TEST_ prefixed template (TEST_refactor_template) and one TEST_ prefixed uploaded document (TEST_refactor_upload.txt) — both via Ramya test lead, low impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor of documents/routes.py into generators.py + transactions_export template is regression-clean. All 11 DocumentType enum values generate via dispatcher. Three split frontend tabs (Details/Payment/Communication) render and behave identically to pre-refactor. WhatsApp send is MOCKED (wa.me link). For future tests use test file /app/backend/tests/test_refactoring_iteration29.py as regression baseline. Important: 'booking_form' and 'terms_and_conditions' doc types listed in problem statement are NOT in DocumentType enum (only used by preview endpoints), so POST /api/documents/generate rejects them with 422 — this is expected, not a bug.

mocked_apis.whatsapp: MOCKED — opens wa.me link only. SendGrid email is real.
